svg.title: Equipotentials of −3q and +q
svg.desc: Computed equipotentials of a charge −3q on the left and +q a distance d to its right. The zero equipotential, drawn heavier, is a circle around the positive charge: it crosses the line between the charges a quarter of the way from +q to −3q, and crosses the axis again d/2 beyond +q; its radius is 3d/8. Inside it, positive equipotentials are loops around +q. Outside it, the potential is negative: loops surround −3q closely, and farther out closed curves enclose both charges, becoming circles like those of a single charge −2q. Faint field lines run from +q to −3q and in toward −3q from far away. The potential increases toward the positive charge and away from the negative charge.
